recipe.title: Route payment operations work to available review teams
recipe.scenario: Operations tasks arrive faster than one team can review them. Assign already-open administrative tasks to authorized teams that have remaining review time. The worklist is advisory: it does not infer fraud, determine eligibility, or move money.

field.name: open-work-items
field.description: Opaque item ID, owner-approved administrative queue, received UTC time, agreed review-by UTC time, fixed duration, and market. Do not include transaction narratives, account identifiers, card data, or fraud scores.

field.name: reviewer-roles
field.description: Opaque reviewer ID, approved administrative task roles, permitted market or queue, UTC working windows, and pinned work. Cross-team access is not implied by free time.

field.name: task-dependencies
field.description: Opaque predecessor and dependent item pairs; a successor can be proposed only after the prerequisite closes or finishes in this worklist.

field.name: queue-policy
field.description: Ordered, owner-supplied service priorities and operating windows by queue. Priority is a scheduling input, not a risk estimate or payment recommendation.

field.name: handoff-minutes
field.description: Nonnegative net reviewer minutes reserved for an approved team transfer.

field.name: proposed-worklist
field.description: Assignment by item reference, reviewer, administrative queue, UTC start and end, and which constraints allowed it. Maximize feasible due-date coverage at authorized teams. No approval, refund, capture, block, or payment action.

field.name: unassigned-items
field.description: Unplaced items with reasons such as no permitted reviewer, missing dependency, conflicting commitment, or insufficient time. A hold means no assignment was found, not that a payment should be denied.
